title: The Complete Guide to Senolytic Compounds: Natural and Pharmaceutical Options | Longevity Dojo
abstract:
A detailed reference guide to senolytic compounds including quercetin, fisetin, dasatinib, and emerging therapies. Learn about sources, mechanisms, dosing, and safety.
Evidence-based training for a longer, healthier life. Access premium content, AI coaching, and interactive tools with our comprehensive longevity platform.
The landscape of senolytic compounds continues to expand rapidly, offering hope for addressing fundamental mechanisms of aging. While pharmaceutical options like dasatinib provide potent effects, natural compounds like quercetin and fisetin offer accessible entry points for those interested in senolytic therapy.
Quercetin and fisetin are the most accessible natural senolytics, available as supplements
Overview: While curcumin itself has limited senolytic activity, synthetic analogs show promise.
